0022600165.text: The 6-0 Memphis Grizzlies, who lead the Southwest and the West, host the 2-4 New Orleans Pelicans, who are 5th in the Southwest and 4 games back. Memphis is without Quinten Post (ankle), Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and Ty Jerome (back soreness), who is averaging 25.8 points per game, while New Orleans is without Dejounte Murray (personal reasons), Jordan Poole (ankle sprain), and Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2 and have not met yet this season, and in their last meeting on January 30, 2026, in New Orleans, the Grizzlies lost 114-106.
